name: Phenix
summary: Macromolecular crystallography and cryo-EM atomic-model building, refinement and validation suite.

steps: Review the current Phenix download and license pages. Non-profit users must request their own academic download password and accept the terms; for-profit work follows the maintainer's industrial access route. Do not put credentials or installer files in this repository.

Have the user select the official release installer for their actual OS and CPU. Follow the platform-specific graphical or command-line setup guide in a user-controlled directory. Do not bypass operating-system security prompts or run the installer without user review.

After installation, use the Phenix-provided command prompt or source phenix_env.sh on Linux/macOS. Check that the installed Phenix version and the phenix.real_space_refine help are accessible. A GUI launch may also be checked interactively.
For cryo-EM, distinguish atomic-model refinement against a map from particle reconstruction. Run a real refinement only with user-approved map/model data and scientific parameters.
install.verify_note: Check the installed version and phenix.real_space_refine help in the official Phenix environment. An actual model-versus-map refinement and result validation are separate scientific checks.

notes: Phenix is available without cost for non-profit work under its terms, but download access is user-specific; for-profit access differs. This catalog does not download or redistribute the suite.
Phenix real-space refinement is for an atomic model against a cryo-EM map; phenix.refine is a crystallographic reciprocal-space workflow. Neither installation nor help output proves model quality.
